comment: Curated, pipeline-facing flow groups. Hand-maintained: these ids are stable and safe to reference from workflows, docs, and bookmarks, so ids never change once published - only the human-facing name and description do. Names are standard QA test-type vocabulary in the same terse area:thing form discovery uses for spec and describe-level flows, because a tester scans a dense table for smoke, sanity, regression and contract, not for prose. Descriptions are shown only as a hover tooltip: one short line saying what runs and roughly what it costs, never a paragraph. Spec-level and describe-level flows are discovered automatically by scripts/test-runner/discover-flows.js and do not belong here.

groups.name: sanity:smoke
groups.description: home, orders, product; one browser pass, a few seconds

groups.name: sanity:all
groups.description: every sanity spec, all 7 pages; under a minute

groups.name: regression:full
groups.description: every Playwright test under tests/e2e; minutes, even across 8 shards

groups.name: functional:positive+negative
groups.description: happy paths plus bad input and a dead orders API; seconds

groups.name: contract:api
groups.description: API responses against openapi.json, no browser; seconds

groups.name: ui:react
groups.description: every screen of the React app at /app; ~1 minute local, longer on CI

groups.name: scenarios:agents
groups.description: self-healing, diagnosis and policy scenarios; several minutes

groups.name: nonfunctional:perf+a11y
groups.description: latency budgets, mobile layout, broken-page detector; 20-30 seconds

groups.name: visual:snapshots
groups.description: screenshot diff on /app/orders; seconds, same-platform baselines needed

groups.name: unit:components
groups.description: Vitest component and helper tests, no browser or app; seconds
